fields.name: Annual Tech Symposium
fields.description: A day-long technical symposium featuring workshops, coding competitions, and tech talks.

fields.name: Cultural Fest 2025
fields.description: Annual cultural festival with music, dance, and theatrical performances.

fields.name: Winter Sports Meet
fields.description: Inter-college sports competition featuring various indoor and outdoor games.

fields.name: Wrestling
fields.description: Competition will happen in Sports Complex

fields.name: HackVerse 2026: 36-Hour National Hackathon
fields.description: Join 500+ top student developers, designers, and innovators to build cutting-edge AI, Web3, and Mobile solutions with mentorship from leading tech giants. Exciting cash prizes, swags, and internship opportunities!

fields.name: RoboWar & Drone Grand Prix 2026
fields.description: Witness combat robotics battles, high-speed autonomous drone racing, and robotic arm automation challenges. Featuring teams from 30+ engineering colleges battling for the ultimate trophy.

fields.name: Premier College Cricket Cup 2027
fields.description: The biggest collegiate T20 cricket tournament of the year! Cheer for your department and college teams as they battle through group stages, semi-finals, and an electrifying grand final under the floodlights.

fields.name: Pulse 2027: Mega Music & Cultural Fest
fields.description: Get ready for an unforgettable night of live musical performances, rock bands, celebrity DJ concerts, and cultural dance showcases. Experience stunning laser light shows, food trucks, and pure energy!

fields.name: Next.js & Cloud Architecture Bootcamp
fields.description: A hands-on, intensive workshop on building and deploying scalable web apps using React, Next.js, Docker, and AWS Cloud. Includes live coding sessions, certificates of completion, and direct industry mentor Q&A.

fields.name: Slam Dunk: Inter-Collegiate Basketball Trophy
fields.description: High-octane collegiate basketball championship featuring fast breaks, three-pointers, and thrilling buzzer-beaters. Come support the campus varsity team as they defend their regional title!

fields.name: GenAI & Deep Learning Masterclass
fields.description: Discover how to fine-tune Large Language Models, build autonomous agent pipelines, and train computer vision models with PyTorch. Guided step-by-step by visiting industry data scientists.

fields.name: CyberShield: National Ethical Hacking Conclave
fields.description: An elite conference and live Capture-the-Flag (CTF) security contest addressing modern zero-day vulnerabilities, network penetration testing, and ethical hacking methodologies with industry leaders.

fields.name: Natya Utsav: Inter-College Theatrical Gala
fields.description: A grand evening celebrating original theatrical performances, street plays (Nukkad Natak), and dramatic monologues presented by prestigious collegiate drama societies across the state.

fields.name: ShutterCraft: Annual Photography Exhibition
fields.description: Curated showcase of over 200 award-winning photographs capturing wildlife, street candid moments, architecture, and astrophotography by talented student photographers.
